create_stream_dataset: create a StreamDataset to prepare fixed-length BPTT batches from tokenized sentences for language model training
create_dataset: create a Dataset to manage sentence-level batching with padding, EOS markers, and length-based grouping for NLP training
create_parallel_dataset: create a ParallelDataset to manage paired sentence batching for machine translation or cross-lingual training tasks
get_iterator_dataset: get an iterator from Dataset that yields shuffled batches grouped by sentence length with configurable tokens per batch
remove_long_sentences: remove sentences exceeding a maximum length threshold from a Dataset or ParallelDataset to filter outliers
